title: Account Freeze Request Resolution
description: Normalized output for account-freeze-request ticket resolution across multiple decision systems

affected_accounts.description: Account numbers affected by this decision. Always an array of strings; normalizes comma-separated or nested account representations

reason_code.description: Categorical reason for decision. Normalizes: numeric codes→enum, one-word reasons→categorical values

evidence_summary.description: Concise summary of supporting evidence (max 300 characters). Consolidates narrative 'why', 'notes', 'summary', or array 'evidence' fields

confidence.description: Optional confidence score (0–1) for the decision

notes.description: Optional additional context (e.g., 'Card still in possession', 'pending fraud desk review')

examples.evidence_summary: 3 disputed transactions totalling 121700 INR. Card still in possession.
Customer requested temporary freeze pending investigation.
